components.name: Primary action button
components.description: Default templui action used for starting monitoring and saving settings.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: #17679b; color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #17679b 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17679b80; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #104f79; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline action button
components.description: Secondary Run once action against the page background.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #cbd5de; border-radius: 5px; background: #eef2f5; color: #172536; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: #e7edf2; color: #25384a; } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #17679b80; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-outline:active { background: #e3eff6; }

components.name: Stop action button
components.description: Destructive templui variant used to stop monitoring.
components.css: .ds-button-stop { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 5px; background: #a8322c; color: #fff; font: 500 14px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-button-stop:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, #a8322c 90%, transparent); } .ds-button-stop:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #a8322c80; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-stop:active { background: #812a25; }

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: Desktop rail links with a filled current-page state; mobile becomes a horizontal row.
components.html: Overview●Environment
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 232px; padding: 12px; background: #1b2637; font: 400 13px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-radius: 4px; color: #bdc9d4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; background: #27374b; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #fff; background: #30445c; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0a438; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-nav { display: flex; width: auto; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-nav-link { flex: none; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 8px; } }

components.name: Settings input
components.description: White settings field with an adjacent visible label and helper text in the page implementation.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #253b4f; font: 650 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 36px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid #bcc9d3; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #172536; font: 400 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #17679b; outline: 2px solid #17679b30; } .ds-input:disabled { background: #eef2f5; color: #526779; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Run status chips
components.description: Outcome labels keep explicit text in addition to color; the sample shows a passing result.
components.html: PASS WARN FAIL
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; font: 750 9px/1.25 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-pass { color: #216647; background: #e2f2e9; border-color: #bddbc8; } .ds-status-warn { color: #875704; background: #fff1d1; border-color: #ead39a; } .ds-status-fail { color: #a8322c; background: #fae8e5; border-color: #e7bfbb; } .ds-status-unknown { color: #465c6f; background: #edf1f4; border-color: #cbd5de; }

components.name: Network path diagram
components.description: Relationship-only host-to-gateway path with factual labels and a responsive vertical arrangement.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-path { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(110px,.6fr) minmax(190px,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 14px; } .ds-node { min-height: 104px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #b9c9d5; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-node-primary { border-color: #8ab2cc; background: #eef6fa; } .ds-node span { color: #526779; font: 750 9px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-node strong { color: #1b344b; font: 600 16px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-node small { color: #526779; font: 400 11px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-connector { display: grid; gap: 9px; text-align: center; color: #526779; font: 400 10px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-connector i { height: 2px; background: #5389a9; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-path { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr); } .ds-connector { justify-items: center; } .ds-connector i { width: 2px; height: 20px; } }

components.name: Results table
components.description: Dense aligned observations with uppercase headings, dividers, and monospace values.
components.css: .ds-table-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow: auto; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #314659; background: #fff; font: 400 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-table thead { background: #e6edf2; } .ds-table th { color: #425a6f; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; font: 700 10px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .065em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 10px 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dce4ea; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f4f8fa; } .ds-table code { color: #163f5b; font: 400 11px/1.3 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
DiagnosticToolkit uses the visual language of a technical reference: cool drafting-white and graphite surfaces, blue rules and links, and compact, aligned data. Its interface is a working instrument for a local operator, not a decorative analytics dashboard. System UI typography keeps labels and explanations familiar; monospace is reserved for addresses and measured values.

The signature is a relationship-only host-to-gateway path built from discovered environment data. Results keep the configured expectation beside the observed status and latency. Monitoring state is explicit, and previous runs remain labeled as history rather than being presented as current results.
keyCharacteristics: Cool light surfaces with a graphite navigation rail and technical blue structure.
Crisp borders, compact tables, and tabular-looking monospace network values.
A labeled topology path that reports host relationships, not geographic scale.
Amber warnings and red failures paired with readable status text.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Status colors reinforce explicit words such as PASS, WARN, and FAIL; color is not the only status cue.

dos: Do use the discovered host, gateway, and route relationship for the topology diagram; retain its labels and directional connector.
Do keep expected outcomes visible beside observed result status and latency.
Do distinguish the current monitoring state from prior runs and label missing host data as unavailable.
Do keep wide tables scrollable and allow long network values to wrap where the layout permits.
donts: Don't imply geographic scale or add network nodes that were not discovered.
Don't communicate a result state with color alone.
Don't present previous run results as the current run when monitoring is idle.
